_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Shock Test Report
summary: The Shock Test Report documents the results of equipment shock tests, post-shock inspections, and functional tests performed under MIL-DTL-901 standard shock test methods.
use_relationship:
The Shock Test Report provides the results of equipment shock tests, post-shock test inspections, and functional tests when equipment is subjected to the standard shock test methods in MIL-DTL-901. The report is used to determine whether tested items meet the requirements of MIL-DTL-901.
a. This data item description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in 3.1.8.7, 3.1.12, and 6.7.2 of MIL-DTL-901.
This report applies to shock testing equipment in accordance with MIL-DTL-901.
Sections 1 and 2 of the report will include input provided by the shock test facility and the activity performing post-shock test inspection. If the shock test facility and post-test inspection facility are other than the contractor, arrangements to ensure that this input is obtained are required.
b. Test reports for alternate shock test vehicles/machines shall be as required by the Technical Authority.
c. This DID supersedes DI-ENVR-80708.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The test report shall be in the contractor's format.

children.title: Distribution Statement.
children.content: When information within the Shock Test Report constitutes Scientific and Technical Information (STINFO), as defined by DoDI 5230.24, the test report shall be marked with the appropriate distribution statement as assigned by the Technical Authority in accordance with DoDI 5230.24.

children.title: General Requirements.
children.content: The test report shall contain the following three sections:

children.title: Section 1: Test installation and conduct.
children.content: This section describes the test installation, conduct, and results of the test, including the applicable information of 3.3 below. This section shall also include:

children.title: Description of the material, size, and type of hold-down bolts
children.content: Description of the material, size, and type of hold-down bolts (and of any other hold-down or locating devices) used to secure or locate the tested items to their foundations or test fixtures during shock tests.

children.title: Clear photographs of each equipment mounting configuration
children.content: Clear photographs of each equipment mounting configuration used during the shock test.

children.title: Drawings of the fixtures, including all modifications to standard fixtures.
children.content: The modifications to the standard fixtures may be included as marked-up drawings.

children.title: If shock test instrumentation is employed
children.content: If shock test instrumentation is employed, a description of such instrumentation and a clear copy of data recorded during the test.

children.title: Reference to the applicable equipment military specifications or acquisition document
children.content: Reference to the applicable equipment military specifications or acquisition document, including the applicable revision and date of issue.

children.title: Section 2: Post-test inspection.
children.content: This section describes the conduct and results of the post-test inspection, including the applicable information in 3.3 below.

children.title: Section 3: Acquisition requirements.
children.content:
This section states the applicable acquisition requirements and supplemental ordering data specified in the acquisition documents in accordance with 6.2 of MIL-DTL-901. This may be accomplished by extracting pertinent pages or sections of the purchase specifications or acquisition document and including this material as an appendix to the report. This section shall include the contractor's recommendations for shock test acceptance of the item tested. For each item of damage (or malfunction) that occurred as a result of shock testing, at least one of the following shall be included:
Where matters involving shock test failures were resolved with the Technical Authority prior to submission of the test report (see 3.1.12 of MIL-DTL-901), a record of these agreements shall include detailed descriptions of any damage incurred during each blow, shot, or drop and, where practicable, clear photographs of each instance of damage. This section shall also describe in detail any design modifications, repairs, or adjustments made to the item during shock tests or prior to post-test functional testing and shall provide the equipment identification information delineated in 3.3.5 below.

children.title: Recommendation and rationale for design modifications
children.content: Recommendation and rationale for design modifications believed to be required to correct any deficiencies found during the test or the post-test inspection to achieve acceptable shock resistance.

children.title: Illustration that the damage or malfunction in question does not violate applicable shock test acceptance criteria.
Specific Requirements.
children.content: Each piece of equipment to be tested shall be identified with the information delineated in 3.3.6 below. Tests shall be numbered and dated.

children.title: Lightweight Shock Machine Test.
children.content: The following information shall be included for all lightweight shock machine tests as defined by MIL-DTL-901:

children.title: Type of test fixture as defined by MIL-DTL-901.
If using type 4C, indicate the mounting platform.
If using type 6E, indicate the panel number.
Total weight supported by the lightweight shock machine anvil plate.
Monitored performance.
children.content: See table I for a sample tabulation format for required information.

children.title: Survey findings, noting any damage and providing damage photographs.
Modifications, if any, accomplished prior to or during test with applicable rationale, description, etc.
If witnessed by a designated Government representative
children.content: If witnessed by a designated Government representative, the report shall include the signature of the witness and certification that the results were accurately recorded. The Government representative signature and certification do not indicate approval or acceptance of the test report.

children.title: Certification of report by the test laboratory.
Medium Weight Shock Machine Test.
children.content: The following information shall be included for all medium weight shock machine tests as defined by MIL-DTL-901:

children.title: Type of test fixture.
children.content: If nonstandard, include description and photographs.

children.title: Total weight supported by the medium weight shock machine anvil table
children.content: Total weight supported by the medium weight shock machine anvil table in accordance with 3.1.2.b of MIL-DTL-901.

children.title: Medium weight shock machine mounting requirements
children.content: Medium weight shock machine mounting requirements in accordance with 3.1.6.3.2 of MIL-DTL-901.

children.title: Monitored performance.
children.content: See table II for a sample tabulation format for required information.

children.title: Survey findings, noting any damage and providing damage photographs.
Modifications, if any, accomplished prior to or during test with applicable rationale, description, sketches, etc.
If witnessed by a designated Government representative
children.content: If witnessed by a designated Government representative, the report shall include the signature of the witness and certification that the results were accurately recorded. The Government representative signature and certification do not indicate approval or acceptance of the test report.

children.title: Certification of the report by the test laboratory.
Heavyweight Shock Test on a Standard Floating Shock Platform (FSP), Extended FSP (EFSP), Intermediate FSP (IFSP), or a Large FSP (LFSP).
children.content: The following information shall be included for all FSP tests as defined by MIL-DTL-901:

children.title: Test platform as defined by MIL-DTL-901.
Test fixture description, including details of the installations.
children.content: Photographs or sketches of the foundation and installation.

children.title: Monitored performance.
children.content: See table III for a sample tabulation format for required information.

children.title: Charge standoff (range) and deck simulating fixture (DSF) frequency
children.content: Charge standoff (range) and deck simulating fixture (DSF) frequency, as necessary, in accordance with MIL-DTL-901

children.title: Survey findings, noting any damage and providing damage photographs.
Modifications, if any, accomplished prior to or during test with applicable rationale, description, sketches, etc.
If witnessed by a designated Government representative
children.content: If witnessed by a designated Government representative, the report shall include the signature of the witness and certification that the results were accurately recorded. The Government representative signature and certification do not indicate approval or acceptance of the test report.

children.title: Certification of the report by the test laboratory.
Deck Simulating Shock Machine (DSSM) Test.
children.content: The following information shall be included for all DSSM tests as defined by MIL-DTL-901:

children.title: Description of test fixture, if used, including figure(s)
children.content: Description of test fixture, if used, including figure(s) (drawings, sketches, photographs, etc.).

children.title: Class II payload center-of-gravity (CG), total isolated payload weight, and fixture weight plus additional weight.
Monitored performance.
children.content: See table IV for a sample tabulation format for required information.

children.title: Swing arm settings, measured from the horizontal
Survey findings, noting any damage and providing damage photographs.
Modifications, if any, accomplished prior to or during test with applicable rationale, description, sketches, etc.
If witnessed by a designated Government representative
children.content: If witnessed by a designated Government representative, the report shall include the signature of the witness and certification that the results were accurately recorded. The Government representative signature and certification do not indicate approval or acceptance of the test report.

children.title: Certification of the report by the test laboratory.
Post-Shock Test - Testing and Inspection.
children.content: The following information shall be included for all tests:

children.title: Identification of item being inspected
children.content: Identification of item being inspected through the use of such information as component name, manufacturer, and drawing number.

children.title: Inspection and functional tests.
children.content: Type of test accomplished and approval by the appropriate inspectors.

children.title: Repairs that were necessary during test.
Condition of the item being tested/inspected.
Comparison with operational requirements.
children.content: Report the results of the comparison of the specified test item operational requirements prior to the test with the results of the post-shock functional testing.

children.title: If witnessed by a designated Government representative
children.content: If witnessed by a designated Government representative, the report shall include the signature of the witness and certification that the results were accurately recorded. The Government representative signature and certification do not indicate approval or acceptance of the test report.

children.title: Certification of the report by the test laboratory.
Equipment Identification and Test Installation Requirements.
children.content: The following information shall be included for all tests:

children.title: Military specification and technical manual numbers
Model number, part number, and serial number (as applicable).
Plan numbers (sectional assembly and outline; revision and date).
Weight (wet, dry, and total weight including test fixture, wet and dry).
Height of CG above base of equipment.
Requirements of MIL-DTL-901 (see classifications in 1.2 of MIL-DTL-901).
Mounting plane aboard ship represented during shock test
Mounting orientation aboard ship represented during shock test
Hold-down bolts (and any other hold-down or locating devices) used for attachment of items to their foundation or test fixture during shock tests.
Description of external or internal resilient mounts, if used.
Major components and attached items in test (name, identification, manufacturer).
